reasoning: The question asks whether March 22 will be warmer than March 15 in Dijon. In mid-March, temperatures typically trend upward as spring progresses. The seasonal forecasts indicate a warmer-than-normal spring is likely (50% probability). Historical climatology for Dijon shows average temperatures rise through March. The 7-day gap between dates means March 22 should naturally be slightly warmer on average due to seasonal progression. However, daily weather variability is substantial, and cooler episodes can occur. Given the upward seasonal trend and warm spring forecast, I estimate slightly better than even odds that March 22 will be warmer.
